name: Securities Transaction Report 7
definition: Details of the securities transaction report.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the transaction.

ExecutingParty.name: Executing Party
ExecutingParty.definition: Identification of the entity executing the transaction.

InvestmentPartyIndicator.name: Investment Party Indicator
InvestmentPartyIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the reporting party is defined as an investment firm under the local regulation or not.

SubmittingParty.name: Submitting Party
SubmittingParty.definition: Entity submitting the transaction report to the competent authority.

Buyer.name: Buyer
Buyer.definition: Identifies the acquirer of the legal title to the financial instrument.

Seller.name: Seller
Seller.definition: Identifies the seller of the legal title to the financial instrument.

OrderTransmission.name: Order Transmission
OrderTransmission.definition: Indication as to whether the transaction results from an order transmitted by the reporting of a client to a third party.||Usage: Only applicable when the conditions for transmission are not satisfied.

Transaction.name: Transaction
Transaction.definition: Provides the details of the reported transaction.

FinancialInstrument.name: Financial Instrument
FinancialInstrument.definition: Financial instrument representing a sum of rights of the investor vis-a-vis the issuer.

InvestmentDecisionPerson.name: Investment Decision Person
InvestmentDecisionPerson.definition: Identifies the person or algorithm which is responsible within the reporting party for the investment decision.

ExecutingPerson.name: Executing Person
ExecutingPerson.definition: Person or algorithm responsible for the execution of the transaction.

AdditionalAttributes.name: Additional Attributes
AdditionalAttributes.definition: Provides additional indicators on the reported transaction.

TechnicalAttributes.name: Technical Attributes
TechnicalAttributes.definition: Data used for exchanges between national competent authorities, not to be used by reporting entities.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
